issue.title: Regression in 2.0
issue.body: In 2.0, export ignores --output and writes to stdout; 1.9 works.

candidates.title: Export output path ignored after upgrade
candidates.body: On 2.0 the --output flag is ignored and CSV goes to stdout.

candidates.title: 1.0 output path permission bug
candidates.body: In 1.0 output files failed if their parent had insufficient permissions; fixed in 1.1.
